versions.changelog:
Initial release of crypto-momentum-signals:

- Provides one-call quantitative momentum signals for any CoinGecko-listed cryptocurrency.
- Returns SMA7/SMA25 trend flag, RSI-14 (Wilder), annualized volatility, price changes (24h/7d/30d), and market cap rank.
- Pay-per-request via $0.0005 USDC on Base (no subscription, API key, or signup required).
- Easy integration for agents handling trend/momentum screening and commentary.
- Works by reading public CoinGecko data and performing server-side quant analysis.
